name: Dead-end lot at the end of Lone Cactus Road (small, ~5 cars)
basis: Directions read: from Loop 101 and Cave Creek Rd go north ~1/2 mile, left on Lone Cactus Rd, road turns and dead-ends at a small parking lot (about five cars); climbing area is ~1/4 mile northwest of it (listed coords 33.6816,-112.0422). Brief node n11751790910 sits ~0.4 km SE of that point, matched by position as the dead-end lot. A 20th St entrance approach was also mentioned but with no parking described, so not used.
